newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle Eaux/Time Warner Cable TV talks continue.
newsitem.headline: Gle Eaux/Time Warner Cable TV talks continue.

text.p: Talks over U.S. media company Time Warner Inc buying France's Cie Generale des Eaux's cable television unit are continuing, Jean-Marie Messier, chairman of Generale des Eaux, told the company's annual meeting.
"Negotiations (with Time Warner) exist, are going on and have not yet concluded," Messier said on Wednesday.
Generale des Eaux said in March it was talking to Time Warner over the sale of its loss-making Compagnie Generale de Videocommunication (CGV), one of three cable television operators in France.
Messier said then that the talks could conclude in four to six weeks' time. NIM/SLA
